title: Few-shot Learning with Multilingual Generative Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the absolute gap in accuracy between predicting male and female samples on a multilingual occupation identification task, using short biographies with names and pronouns removed.

Evaluating representation disparities by analyzing the number of few-shot examples that fit within the model's context length across different languages, caused by unequal representation in the multilingual BPE vocabulary.

Comparing in-context learning performance using prompts with uniform class distributions versus skewed (majority label) class distributions to evaluate the impact of training set skewness on predictions.
